title: JWST observations of the Ring Nebula (NGC 6720): I. Imaging of the rings, globules, and arcs

evidence.locator: The observations: NIRCam filters F162M, F212N, F300M and F335M. Sect. 4.1: the central cavity, about 25 arcsec in radius, is filled with high-ionisation gas; the shell's emission is clumpy, especially in filters dominated by H2. Sect. 5.5: the F162M image holds continuum, presumably free-free emission, and hydrogen recombination lines, fainter than the molecular hydrogen emission "which dominates the other three NIRCam images".
